question: As on July 2023, India's External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar filed his nomination papers for the Rajya Sabha elections from which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of July 2023, India's External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar filed his nomination papers for the Rajya Sabha elections from **Gujarat**.
 
• S. Jaishankar is a seasoned diplomat and has previously served as Foreign Secretary of India.
 
• He has been serving as the External Affairs Minister since May 2019.
 
• Jaishankar played a crucial role in shaping India's foreign policy during his tenure.
 
• Gujarat:
 
 
• Capital - Gandhinagar
 
• Chief Minister - Bhupendra Patel
 
• Governor - Acharya Devvrat
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajya Sabha**

 
 
• The Rajya Sabha is the upper house of the Parliament of India.
 
• It is a permanent body and is not subject to dissolution, but one-third of its members retire every two years.
 
• Members of the Rajya Sabha are elected by the elected members of State Legislative Assemblies.
 
• The Vice President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
 
 
 
• **S. Jaishankar**
 
 
• Full name - Subrahmanyam Jaishankar
 
• Born on January 9, 1955
 
• He is a former Indian diplomat and the current Minister of External Affairs of India.
 
• He was appointed as Foreign Secretary in January 2015.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat in Politics**
 
 
• Gujarat has been a significant state in Indian politics, often seen as a stronghold of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• It is the home state of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
 
• The state has a rich political history and has contributed several key leaders to national politics.
